items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: "He said, 'You know, Quentin,' he said, 'how would you like to join my band?' I told him I'd love to."

ctx.x: He said, "Do you belong to the union?" I said,
"Sure, I belong to the union. I belong to the little local at home." Paid 75 cents a quarter dues. That was 1929.

So Helvey said, "Well, I'll come through and pick you up tomorrow." Well, I had a little horn I had bought out of a pawnshop for nine $6, [Kenon] It was a silver horn, had a -- oh, the bore was so small you called it a pea-shooter in those days.
